stem.text: Two solid spheres form an isolated system. Sphere X moves with speed $6\,\text{cm s}^{-1}$ in a straight line directly towards a stationary sphere Y, as shown.

stem.alt: Sphere X on the left and sphere Y on the right. An arrow labelled 6 cm s-1 points from sphere X towards sphere Y.

stem.text: The spheres have a perfectly elastic collision. After the collision, sphere X moves with speed $2\,\text{cm s}^{-1}$ in the same direction as before the collision.
What is the speed of sphere Y?
